rows.myth: Muscle fibres get shorter because actin and myosin shrink
rows.factDetail: Actin slides over myosin; only the I-band and H-zone shorten.

rows.myth: Muscles can push as well as pull
rows.factDetail: Movement in both directions needs antagonistic pairs, e.g. biceps and triceps.

rows.myth: Cardiac muscle is under voluntary control
rows.factDetail: It contracts rhythmically on its own, set by the SA node.
